# Publications

```{r}
#| label: publications
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

# Read from data/publications.csv, the ORCID-based list behind the website, so
# the CV and the publications page agree. Numbered newest-highest, as on the site.
pubs <- read.csv(here::here("data", "publications.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
pubs <- pubs[pubs$kind %in% c("article", "preprint"), ]
# Drop DOIs set to `hide` in the overrides file, as the publications page does.
overrides <- read.csv(here::here("data", "publications_overrides.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
hidden <- tolower(overrides$doi[overrides$action %in% "hide"])
pubs <- pubs[!tolower(pubs$doi) %in% hidden, ]
pubs <- pubs[order(-suppressWarnings(as.integer(pubs$year)), pubs$title), ]
n <- nrow(pubs)
cat(sprintf("%d papers and preprints, newest first. Full list with links at [dsimons.org/publications](https://www.dsimons.org/publications.html).\n\n", n))
# Long author lists are cut to six, keeping Simons D visible, as on the website.
short_authors <- function(a) {
  parts <- strsplit(a, ",\\s*")[[1]]
  if (length(parts) <= 8) return(paste(parts, collapse = ", "))
  me <- grep("\\bSimons D\\b", parts)
  shown <- parts[1:6]
  if (length(me) && me[1] > 6) shown <- c(shown, "…", parts[me[1]])
  paste(c(shown, "et al."), collapse = ", ")
}
for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  authors <- gsub("\\bSimons D\\b", "**Simons D**", short_authors(pubs$authors[i]))
  journal_name <- gsub("&amp;", "&", pubs$journal[i], fixed = TRUE)
  journal <- if (!is.na(journal_name) && nzchar(journal_name)) paste0(" *", journal_name, "*.") else ""
  preprint <- if (pubs$kind[i] == "preprint") " Preprint." else ""
  # A paragraph per paper with the number in bold: a Markdown list would
  # renumber upwards from the first number.
  cat(sprintf("**%d.** %s (%s). %s.%s%s\n\n", n - i + 1, authors, pubs$year[i], sub("[.]$", "", pubs$title[i]), journal, preprint))
}
```
